description: Search published real estate listings on Objelio. Pass structured criteria (preferred) or the user's request as text. Returns up to 10 listings with price, area, rooms, a fit per criterion (erfuellt = met, abweichend = slightly outside, unbekannt = no information) and a link to the listing page where the user can contact the agent.

criteria.description: Structured search criteria. Leave out fields the user did not mention.

features_preferred.description: Nice-to-have features, only affect the order.

features_required.description: Must-have features. Listings without information stay in the results as unknown.

living_area_min_qm.description: Minimum living area in square meters.

locations.description: Several locations mean any of them. With umkreis_km, listings around the place are found and each result has entfernung_km.

ort.description: Town or city, e.g. Paderborn. Also matches district names.

ortsteil.description: District, e.g. Schloß Neuhaus. Ignored with umkreis_km.

plz.description: German postal code or its beginning, e.g. 33104 or 331.

umkreis_km.description: Radius in km around ort or a five-digit plz, for requests like "within 20 km of Bielefeld" or "near Paderborn" (use 10 km when no number is given). Covers all of Germany.

notes_unmapped.description: Wishes that fit no field (e.g. quiet location). They do not filter and are shown back to the user.

offer_type.description: "kauf" (buy) or "miete" (rent). Currently almost all listings are for sale.

property_subtypes.description: Only if the user explicitly names a subtype, e.g. doppelhaushaelfte (semi-detached house), reihenhaus, penthouse.

rooms_min.description: Minimum number of rooms (German count, kitchen and bath excluded).

year_built_min.description: Built in or after this year.

text.description: The user's request in their own words (German or English), used only if criteria is missing.

name: search_listings

anzahl.description: Total number of matching listings, demo listings included.

anzahl_echt.description: Number of real listings (without demo listings). Real listings come first in treffer.

kriterien.description: The applied criteria in German words.

suchauftrag_link.description: Page on objelio.de to get new matching listings by e-mail. The user enters the address there, never in the chat.

suchprofil_link.description: Short questionnaire on objelio.de (location, size, budget, financing) with budget range, purchase costs, matching listings and a search alert. Offer it when the user's wishes are still vague.

angebot.description: kauf = for sale, miete = for rent.

demo.description: true = demo listing with invented data, not for sale or rent.

entfernung_km.description: Only for radius searches: straight-line distance in km to the searched place (null = unknown). Not a driving distance.

link.description: Listing page on objelio.de, where the user contacts the agent. Always show it.

objektart.description: Property type in German, e.g. Etagenwohnung, Einfamilienhaus.

passung.description: Fit per search criterion, in German.

unbekannt.description: Criteria the agent gave no information on.

preis_auf_anfrage.description: true = the agent does not publish the price (price on request); preis_eur is then null. Say so and never estimate a price.

vergleich_link.description: Side-by-side comparison of the first three listings on objelio.de, where the user can save them and contact the agents.

vorschlaege.description: Wider searches with their number of real listings, only when there is no real listing. Offer them to the user.

title: Search listings
